system.boundary: Build a 2 s closed-loop active-suspension quarter-car model in Simulink.
engineering_objects: The mechanical plant must include a sprung body mass, an unsprung wheel mass, a suspension spring and damper between them, tyre compliance to the moving road, and an active force actuator acting between the body and wheel.
The applied actuator force must feed the same mechanical path that produces body acceleration and suspension deflection;
Use its sprung mass, suspension stiffness, suspension damping, road peak, and road angular frequency in the connected plant and disturbance path.
physical_paths: The applied actuator force must feed the same mechanical path that produces body acceleration and suspension deflection; prescribed output histories, disconnected control paths, or replayed trajectories are not valid.
Use its sprung mass, suspension stiffness, suspension damping, road peak, and road angular frequency in the connected plant and disturbance path.
Changes in sprung mass, suspension parameters, and road magnitude or frequency must materially affect the connected dynamic response.

The mechanical plant must include a sprung body mass, an unsprung wheel mass, a suspension spring and damper between them, tyre compliance to the moving road, and an active force actuator acting between the body and wheel.
functional_paths: A feedback controller must use measured suspension and body motion to command the actuator.
prescribed output histories, disconnected control paths, or replayed trajectories are not valid.
The closed loop must remain finite and stable across the complete published ranges while balancing passenger comfort, tyre/suspension travel, and active control effort.

interfaces.name: xauto11_input
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read xauto11_input from the MATLAB base workspace. The xauto11_input struct contains finite real scalar fields sprung_mass_kg in [100, 300] kg, suspension_stiffness_n_per_m in [12800, 19200] N/m, suspension_damping_n_s_per_m in [700, 1300] N*s/m, road_peak_m in [0.04, 0.07] m, and road_angular_frequency_rad_per_s in [8*pi, 12*pi] rad/s.

interfaces.name: suspension_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named suspension_state and active_control_state. suspension_state has width 5 in this order: road displacement, body displacement, wheel displacement, and suspension deflection (m), followed by body acceleration (m/s^2). suspension_state must contain the actual connected road, body, wheel, suspension-deflection, and body-acceleration signals.

interfaces.name: active_control_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named suspension_state and active_control_state. active_control_state has width 2 in this order: the controller's dimensionless normalized command and the applied active force (N). active_control_state must contain the controller's dimensionless normalized command and the physical force in newtons actually applied to the mechanical plant after actuator dynamics and force scaling.

signs_and_coordinates: A feedback controller must use measured suspension and body motion to command the actuator.

active_control_state must contain the controller's dimensionless normalized command and the physical force in newtons actually applied to the mechanical plant after actuator dynamics and force scaling.
